message: The other day, our family group chat lit up with ideas on how to keep the little ones safe during emergencies. It's heartwarming to see everyone so invested in preparedness, especially when it comes to the grandkids. I stumbled upon a wonderful resource that offers fun ways for kids to learn about safety and what to do in different situations. It’s a gentle reminder that preparedness doesn’t have to be stressful — it can actually be a bonding experience. How do you all teach your children about staying safe?
